eok_arabia.name: Arabia Drylands
eok_arabia.description: Open yellow dryland inspired by classic Arabia-style 1v1 maps: four corner starts, green scrub patches, pine clusters, walkable hills, gold, stone, and wandering animals.

temperate_valley.name: Forest Lake Valley
temperate_valley.description: Green historical battlefield with forest wood lines, a few small lakes, huntable animals, gold, and stone.
